entries.name: jdk-utf8-decode-str-sur-v0#0
entries.description: [str-sur] The String ⟨ED A0 80⟩, an encoded surrogate: ONE U+FFFD, written `66 03 EF BF BD`. SEPARATING: a port that keeps the bytes echoes; a decoder that replaces per maximal subpart writes three U+FFFD (`66 09 …`).

entries.name: jdk-utf8-decode-str-sur-ascii-v0#1
entries.description: [str-sur-ascii] The String ⟨ED A0 41⟩: `ED A0` is one U+FFFD (the JDK takes the continuation byte after `ED`), then `A`: written `66 04 EF BF BD 41`. SEPARATING, as str-sur.

entries.name: jdk-utf8-decode-str-overlong3-v0#2
entries.description: [str-overlong3] The String ⟨E0 80 80⟩, an overlong form: one U+FFFD PER BYTE, written `66 09 EF BF BD × 3`. SEPARATING: a decoder that replaces the overlong sequence once writes `66 03 EF BF BD`.

entries.name: jdk-utf8-decode-str-above-v0#3
entries.description: [str-above] The String ⟨F4 90 80 80⟩, a code point above U+10FFFF: one U+FFFD per byte, written `66 0C EF BF BD × 4`. SEPARATING, as str-overlong3.

entries.name: jdk-utf8-decode-str-valid-v0#4
entries.description: [str-valid] The String ⟨E2 82 AC⟩ (€), well-formed: written back as read. CONTROL.
